database.description: The database the query reads (a bucket on InfluxDB 2.x). Needed for every query but SHOW DATABASES.

query.description: One read. SQL (InfluxDB 3 only): SELECT, WITH … SELECT, SHOW or EXPLAIN. InfluxQL: SELECT without INTO, or SHOW DATABASES, MEASUREMENTS, SERIES, TAG KEYS, TAG VALUES, FIELD KEYS or RETENTION POLICIES. Flux isn't supported.

language.description: The query language. Default: sql on InfluxDB 3, influxql on InfluxDB 1.x and 2.x.

parameters.description: Values of the query's $name placeholders, such as {"host": "web-1"}.

limit.description: Most rows to return; the connection and the endpoint cap it.
